title: Claude checks my calendar and books the meeting itself
description:
Claude connected to Google Calendar reads your real schedule, finds a free slot, and books the meeting for you. I show the whole flow on my phone: connect the Google Calendar connector once, type one plain-English sentence with the window and the title, and Claude scans your week, spots the gap, and creates the event, right time and name. Open the calendar app and it's already there. Full step by step guide + the exact prompt: https://vascoyaps.com/resources/calendar-claude-connector
#ClaudeAI #GoogleCalendar #Productivity #AITools #vascoyaps
